$comment: The Mutual NDA cover page's fields, shared by the frontend form and the backend's AI extraction. Both sides are tested against this file, so a field added here and missed on one side fails the suite rather than leaving a gap in a signed agreement. Dotted names address nested values: 'partyOne.company' is values.partyOne.company. 'label' is how a field is named to the assistant, which is told to speak plainly - the machine-facing 'name' is never meant to reach a user. 'default' is what the template prints before anyone says anything, and is treated as unconfirmed until the user speaks to it.

fields.name: purpose
fields.label: what the confidential information may be used for
fields.description: Why the parties are sharing confidential information - the business reason it may be used for. A phrase, not a sentence about the NDA itself.
fields.default: Evaluating whether to enter into a business relationship with the other party.

fields.name: effectiveDate
fields.label: the date the agreement starts
fields.description: The date the agreement takes effect, written as ISO 8601 yyyy-mm-dd. Convert whatever the user says into that form.

fields.name: mndaTermType
fields.label: how the agreement ends
fields.description: Whether the agreement runs for a set number of years, or carries on until one side ends it.

valueLabels.expires: runs for a set number of years
valueLabels.untilTerminated: carries on until one side ends it

fields.name: mndaTermYears
fields.label: how many years the agreement runs
fields.description: How many years the agreement runs before it expires. Needed only when the agreement runs for a set number of years rather than carrying on until someone ends it.

fields.name: confidentialityTermType
fields.label: how long confidentiality lasts
fields.description: Whether confidentiality lasts a set number of years, or forever.

valueLabels.years: lasts a set number of years

fields.name: confidentialityYears
fields.label: how many years confidentiality lasts
fields.description: How many years confidential information stays protected. Needed only when confidentiality lasts a set number of years rather than forever.

fields.name: governingLaw
fields.label: which state's law governs the agreement
fields.description: The US state whose law governs the agreement.

fields.name: jurisdiction
fields.label: where any dispute would be heard
fields.description: Where legal proceedings must be brought: a city or county and state, such as 'New Castle, DE'.

fields.name: partyOne.company
fields.label: the first party's company name
fields.description: Legal company name of the first party.

fields.name: partyOne.printName
fields.label: who signs for the first party
fields.description: Full name of the person signing for the first party.

fields.name: partyOne.title
fields.label: the first party signatory's job title
fields.description: Job title of the first party's signatory.

fields.name: partyOne.noticeAddress
fields.label: where the first party receives notices
fields.description: Where the first party receives formal notices: an email or a postal address.

fields.name: partyTwo.company
fields.label: the second party's company name
fields.description: Legal company name of the second party.

fields.name: partyTwo.printName
fields.label: who signs for the second party
fields.description: Full name of the person signing for the second party.

fields.name: partyTwo.title
fields.label: the second party signatory's job title
fields.description: Job title of the second party's signatory.

fields.name: partyTwo.noticeAddress
fields.label: where the second party receives notices
fields.description: Where the second party receives formal notices: an email or a postal address.

fields.name: modifications
fields.label: any changes to the standard terms
fields.description: Any agreed changes to the standard terms. Left empty, the document records 'None.'
